gemini_description.purpose: To provide crucial safety, installation, and maintenance guidelines for AstralPool swimming pool pump units.
gemini_description.summary: This document outlines safety regulations, operator qualifications, environmental operational limits, and electrical compliance standards (such as IEC/HD 60364-7-702) required for the safe installation, startup, and maintenance of swimming pool filtration and recirculation pumps.

components.name: Pool Filtration/Recirculation Pump
components.description: The primary equipment designed specifically for water filtration and recirculation in swimming pools.

components.name: Drainage System / Drain
components.description: A suitable drain required in the installation area to manage potential water overflow or flooding.

procedure: Read and understand the safety, installation, and startup instructions in the manual prior to initiating any work.
Verify that all assembly and maintenance operations are carried out exclusively by authorized, qualified personnel.
Ensure the pump is installed in compliance with standard IEC/HD 60364-7-702 and national swimming pool regulations.
Confirm that the pump is not installed in Zone 0 or Zone 1.
Provide a suitable drainage outlet in areas where water flooding or overflow is likely to occur.

technical_details.detail: Installation compliance standard: IEC/HD 60364-7-702 and national pool regulations.
Prohibited installation zones: Zone 0 and Zone 1 (refer to page 97 of the manual for visual diagrams).
The instruction manual is available in PDF format at www.astralpool.com.

warnings.warning: It is strictly forbidden to install the pump within Zone 0 or Zone 1.
All assembly and maintenance tasks must be executed by authorized, qualified personnel who have thoroughly read the manual.
This equipment is not intended for use by persons (including children) with reduced physical, sensory, or mental capabilities, or lack of experience, unless supervised.
Children must be supervised to ensure they do not play with the device, and they must not perform cleaning or maintenance without supervision.
A suitable drain must be placed in any location where water is expected to overflow or flood.
